title: CWP/6422/2021 of JASVIR SINGH AND ANR Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text:
PRIYANKA IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 224 CWP-6422-2021 (O&M) Date of Decision: 17.11.2025 JASVIR SINGH ANDANR a PETITIONERS Vs. STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS ~__..... RESPONDENTS CORAM: HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA Present: Mr. Shreesh Kakkar, Advocate for the petitioners. Mr. Charanpreet Singh, AAG, Punjab. seok ses DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA, J. (ORAL)

1. In the present writ petition, the petitioners have challenged the order dated 23.02.2021 (Annexure P-5) passed by respondent No.2, whereby the claim of the petitioners for fixing the pay at par with their junior was rejected.

2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners fairly submits that a perusal of para No.6 of the written statement would show that the order in question is reviewable after the finalization of the seniority of Master Cadre. He further submits that now, the respondents have finalised the seniority of Master Cadre and the present writ petition may be disposed of with a direction to consider the case of the petitioners.

3. Learned counsel for the respondents-State does not oppose the prayer made by learned counsel for the petitioners.

4. In view of the above and without commenting upon the merits of the case, the present petition is disposed of with a direction to the respondents to consider and decide the case of the petitioners for fixing the pay afresh in light PRIYANKA CWP-6422-2021 (O&M) -2- 202s PHC: 150088 from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.

5. Pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, stand(s) disposed of. (DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA) JUDGE 17.11.2025 Ramandeep (P)
